name: day-two-walk
title: A real user's second day: continuation, and what the capabilities cannot tell you
description: Simulated a user returning to the same project the next day. Read what survived, ran a real second task, and fixed findings on the spot. Readings: an unchanged mode declaration stops every tool but explains itself exactly; yesterday's work was finished and never committed; the agent caught that the change contradicts the project's declared engine floor, and the model's claim that upstream did the same is false; agent_task_convergence refused until a formal task existed, and agent_project_task then wrote a PRD whose acceptance criteria are a placeholder. Continuation itself is still unread.
creator: aixi
